evals.prompt: Reset the secrets-hygiene directive — somebody locally edited it and now it's failing weird. Put it back to whatever was pinned.
evals.expected_output: Following RESET_FLOW.md Steps 1–7: the skill reads `.governance/packs.lock`, confirms `secrets-hygiene` is owned by `governance-kit/core` (`source: builtin`), resolves the pristine source from the kit-bundled tree, computes the byte-diff vs the installed copy, prints the diff (diff-before-exec), asks for explicit `yes`, replaces the directive folder, restores its CONSTITUTION subsection, regenerates the hook dispatcher, smoke-tests, and commits one atomic commit with subject `chore(governance): reset secrets-hygiene to governance-kit/core@<short-sha>`. Hand-authored directives (the `acme/drifted-repo` pack's `team-policy`) are preserved by default. Working tree is unstaged otherwise.
assertions: The skill read `.governance/packs.lock` and identified `secrets-hygiene` as owned by `governance-kit/core` (`source: builtin`)
The skill printed the per-directive diff between the installed `secrets-hygiene/check.sh` and the pristine source before any file was written
The skill asked for an explicit `yes` to execute (no silent acceptance of a default)
The installed `.governance/packs/governance-kit/core/directives/secrets-hygiene/` folder was overwritten with the pristine source (drifted lines removed)
`CONSTITUTION.md`'s `### secrets-hygiene` subsection was restored to match the pristine `constitution.md`
The hook dispatcher was regenerated (or explicitly noted as unchanged in the report)
Hand-authored directives (e.g. `acme/drifted-repo`'s `team-policy`) were NOT touched — listed under `Preserved:` in the report
Exactly one new commit was created with subject `chore(governance): reset secrets-hygiene to governance-kit/core@<short-sha>` (with `(#N)` issue anchor)
An Evolution Log entry dated today was appended naming the reset scope and the pinned SHA
The skill did not push — the report's `Next:` field reads `git push`

evals.prompt: Reset every directive that came from the acme/widgets pack — we want them at exactly the SHA we pinned.
evals.expected_output: Following RESET_FLOW.md with `--pack acme/widgets`: the skill resolves the pinned SHA from `.governance/packs.lock`, ensures the cache entry exists at `${GOVERNANCE_KIT_HOME:-~/.governance/cache}/packs/acme__widgets@<sha>/` (re-fetches if missing), restores every directive in `lock.packs[acme/widgets].directives`, regenerates hooks, commits with subject `chore(governance): reset pack acme/widgets to pinned <short-sha>`. `secrets-hygiene` (owned by `governance-kit/core`) and `team-policy` (hand-authored in `acme/drifted-repo`) are NOT touched.
assertions: The skill resolved the cache directory at `${GOVERNANCE_KIT_HOME:-$HOME/.governance/cache}/packs/acme__widgets@<sha>/` (with `/` encoded as `__`) and re-fetched via `packverb fetch` if the cache was missing
Every directive in `acme/widgets`'s lockfile entry had its installed folder overwritten with the pristine source
`secrets-hygiene` (owned by `governance-kit/core`) was NOT touched
Hand-authored directives owned by `acme/drifted-repo` (`source: local`) were NOT touched
Exactly one commit was created with subject `chore(governance): reset pack acme/widgets to pinned <short-sha>`
The report names: Scope (`--pack acme/widgets`), Restored directive list with `<pack>@<sha>` source, Smoke-test result, Committed sha+subject, and `Next: git push`

evals.prompt: Reset every directive — but show me the plan first, don't commit.
evals.expected_output: Following RESET_FLOW.md with `--all --dry-run`: the skill computes the plan for every pack-sourced directive, prints the per-directive diffs (or a `fetch required` note when a `gh`-source pin is not cached locally) and the would-commit subject, but performs no writes and creates no commit. `--drop-handauthored` was NOT requested, so hand-authored directives are listed under Preserved.
assertions: No files were modified — every directive folder, `CONSTITUTION.md`, the lockfile, and `.governance/freshness.conf` are byte-identical to the fixture
No commit was created
The summary's mode/scope reads `--all --dry-run` and the planned-commit subject is prefixed with `would-commit:`
The summary lists every pack-sourced directive that *would* be restored (across both `governance-kit/core` and `acme/widgets`)
Hand-authored directives are listed under `Preserved:` (no `--drop-handauthored`)

Per-directive diffs were printed where the pristine source is available offline (i.e., for `governance-kit/core` builtin directives); for `gh`-source directives whose pinned SHA isn't in the local cache at `${GOVERNANCE_KIT_HOME:-$HOME/.governance/cache}/packs/<slug>@<sha>/`, the plan explicitly notes that fetch is required rather than depending on network access during dry-run

evals.prompt: Reset all the directives. The packs.lock file is missing because somebody deleted it.
evals.expected_output: Following RESET_FLOW.md's Interaction policy: with `.governance/packs.lock` missing, the skill refuses to run and tells the user reset is lockfile-driven (no safe heuristic for pack provenance). It directs the user to the recovery path: `governance uninstall` + `governance init`. No files are mutated.
assertions: No files were created, deleted, or modified
The skill explicitly refused to run because `.governance/packs.lock` is missing
The skill named the recovery path: `governance uninstall` followed by `governance init`
The skill did NOT fall back to a heuristic and did NOT make assumptions about pack provenance

evals.prompt: Reset everything to pinned, and drop the hand-authored directives too — we want a clean slate.
evals.expected_output: Following RESET_FLOW.md with `--all --drop-handauthored`: the skill restores every pack-sourced directive (`governance-kit/core` + `acme/widgets`) AND deletes every directive owned by `source: local` packs (including the `team-policy` directive in `acme/drifted-repo`). The local pack's `pack.yaml` is removed if it has no surviving directives, and its lockfile entry is removed too. The commit subject is `chore(governance): reset all directives + drop hand-authored`.
assertions: Every pack-sourced directive folder under `governance-kit/core` and `acme/widgets` was restored to its pinned source
The hand-authored `team-policy` directive folder in `acme/drifted-repo` was deleted
If `team-policy` was `acme/drifted-repo`'s only directive, the pack's `pack.yaml` was deleted, the empty pack directory was removed, and the lockfile entry was `lock-remove`d
`CONSTITUTION.md` no longer has a `### team-policy` subsection
Exactly one commit was created with subject `chore(governance): reset all directives + drop hand-authored` and the issue anchor
The Evolution Log gained two entries: one for the restored directives (grouped per pack) and one for the dropped hand-authored directives
The report's `Dropped:` field lists `team-policy` and `Preserved:` is `none`
